text: On 14 October we moved service ledger-api from release 6.3.1 to 6.3.2 at 21:05 UTC. The first health check passed, but requests with header X-Region: north began returning 504 after about 90 seconds. We saw 23 affected requests between 21:07 and 21:19; requests without that header continued to return 200. I do not know whether the new release caused the timeout because the upstream trace for span sp-77 is missing. At 21:24, Noor rolled the service back to 6.3.1, and the 504s stopped in the next check. We have not yet repeated the test on 6.3.2. Please ask the platform team to preserve the missing trace data if it can be recovered, and send an update before 09:00 tomorrow. The customer says this is the second time the same region has been affected this month.
review_constraints: Keep the sequence, all statuses/counts/times/releases, conditional unknown cause, rollback and observed recovery, unrun repeat test, preservation request/deadline and customer criticism.
